notes.title: Price update - Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Inti Creates dev team here.

We wanted to let you know that we have addressed the issues arisen in regards with regional pricing in various regions, and the updated prices are now live in on the storefront.

The following regions/currencies have received adjusted prices:

Turkey (Lira)
Russia (Ruble)
Brazil (Real)
Chile (Peso)
Columbia (Peso)
Peru (Sol)
Argentina (Peso)
Costa Rica (Colón)
Uruguay (Peso)
Indonesia (Rupee)
Malaysia (Ringgit)
Philippines (Peso)
Thailand (Baht)
Vietnam (Dong）
China（Yuan）
India（Rupee）
Sauna Arabia（Rial）
UAE（Dirham）
Kuwait（Dinar）
Qatar（Rial）
Kazakhstan（Tenge）

Thank you all for your patience and understanding. If you are in one of these affected regions and already purchased the game before the adjustment, please reach out to Steam support for assistance.
